page.title: From complex challenge to scalable product.
page.subtitle: We start with one valuable scientific or engineering challenge, prove measurable value with real evidence and grow the validated result into a deployable system.
page.insight_copy: Oracles combine Pythia predictions, domain constraints, uncertainty, and adaptive AI-based user experiences in one usable system.
page.hpc_copy: High-Performance Computing on systems including VSC-5 generates the data that Pythia compresses into fast, explainable prediction.

engagement.title: Start focused. Prove value. Scale together.

phases.title: Start focused
phases.copy: Select one valuable scientific or engineering challenge with a clear user, evidence base, decision and measurable outcome.
phases.result: Output — explicit problem frame and success criteria

phases.title: Prove value
phases.copy: Build the smallest interactive demonstrator with the customer's data and domain knowledge; validate or falsify the central assumption early.
phases.result: Output — evidence-backed go, redesign or stop decision

phases.title: Scale together
phases.copy: Turn the validated demonstrator into a reliable deployment, platform capability and long-term partnership without restarting from zero.
phases.result: Output — deployable product and recurring platform value

copy.mission: Pythia turns data into surrogate prediction. Oracles turn prediction into decisions and engineered results.

workflow.title: Prototype locally. Scale on VSC-5. Validate before deployment.
workflow.introduction: Start small, test the decisive assumption early and use supercomputing only after the evidence justifies scale.

phases.title: Contact & context analysis
phases.copy: Requirements, data, target variables and constraints become an explicit problem frame.

phases.title: Predesign
phases.copy: Decompose the problem; define architecture, validation metrics and stop criteria.

phases.title: Rapid MVP prototyping
phases.copy: Implement the smallest end-to-end workflow and test it on deliberately small datasets.

phases.title: Local pretraining on the calyr.aí Cube
phases.copy: Iterate rapidly on the surrogate, data pipeline, features and training logic before consuming large-scale compute.

phases.title: Evidence and specification gate
phases.copy: Review model behavior, data quality, compute demand, expected value and stop criteria against the project specification.

phases.title: Scale training on VSC-5
phases.copy: Run the computationally intensive simulation, training and search workloads on VSC-5 only when the local MVP supports the central assumption.

phases.title: Validation and falsification
phases.copy: Challenge the scaled result against independent reference data, simulations, uncertainty checks and the success criteria defined before training.

phases.title: Deployable MVP with validity envelope
phases.copy: Package the validated model as a demonstrator, API, interface or decision system with provenance, uncertainty and explicit operating limits.

decisions.positive: Evidence supports scale — allocate VSC-5 compute
decisions.negative: Evidence is insufficient — redesign, simplify or stop

decisions.positive: Validation gate passed — package the deployable MVP
decisions.negative: Validation gate failed — return to data, predesign or local pretraining

feedback_loops.title: MVP learning loop
feedback_loops.trigger: The demonstrator exposes a wrong target, missing constraint or weak value hypothesis.
feedback_loops.action: Reframe the problem and revise predesign before adding model complexity.

feedback_loops.title: Evidence gate loop
feedback_loops.trigger: Data quality, model behavior, expected value or compute justification does not pass specification review.
feedback_loops.action: Return to data, architecture or local pretraining; simplify or stop when the assumption remains unsupported.

feedback_loops.title: VSC-5 scale loop
feedback_loops.trigger: Large-scale training reveals instability, sensitivity, bottlenecks or insufficient generalization.
feedback_loops.action: Feed diagnostics back into the local MVP, features, sampling strategy and training logic before another VSC-5 run.

feedback_loops.title: Validation loop
feedback_loops.trigger: Independent evidence falsifies the model or narrows its useful operating range.
feedback_loops.action: Return to the earliest stage responsible for the failure, then repeat every downstream gate.

feedback_loops.title: Deployment learning loop
feedback_loops.trigger: Monitoring detects drift, new use conditions, user corrections or previously unseen evidence.
feedback_loops.action: Capture the observation as new evidence, update locally, rescale only if necessary and revalidate before release.

questions: Does the problem definition match the available evidence?
Does the MVP already create measurable value?
Does model quality justify the next scale step?
Does VSC-5 training improve the relevant target metrics?
Can the central assumption be validated or falsified?
workflow.closing: Learn locally. Scale deliberately. Feed evidence back. Revalidate before release.
